name: rexo-core
description: Canonical Meme Coin Launchpad Engine for Rialo Venus — v2 Config-Driven & Pull-Fee Architecture

instructions.name: initialize
instructions.description: Luncurkan token baru dengan parameter kurva dan fee dari LaunchConfig

instructions.name: buy_exact_in
instructions.description: Beli token dengan jumlah quote tepat, slippage proteksi min_base_out

instructions.name: buy_exact_out
instructions.description: Beli token dengan target jumlah base tepat, batasan max_quote_in

instructions.name: sell_exact_in
instructions.description: Jual token dengan jumlah base tepat, slippage proteksi min_quote_out

instructions.name: sell_exact_out
instructions.description: Jual token untuk mendapatkan target quote tepat, batasan max_base_in

instructions.name: claim_protocol_fee
instructions.description: Tarik akumulasi fee protokol dari quote_vault ke treasury

instructions.name: claim_partner_fee
instructions.description: Tarik akumulasi fee partner (launchpad operator) dari quote_vault

instructions.name: claim_creator_fee
instructions.description: Tarik akumulasi fee creator dari quote_vault

instructions.name: claim_creator_tokens
instructions.description: Klaim vested token kreator setelah migrasi selesai

instructions.name: migrate
instructions.description: Handler migrasi otomatis yang dipicu reaktif oleh chain setelah kurva selesai

instructions.name: get_state
instructions.description: Lihat status lifecycle, progress_bps, harga, market cap, dan fee outstanding
